snippet.title: No Such Place - Official Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at gameplay and the dangerous world of No Such Place in this trailer for the upcoming top-down paranormal extraction shooter game. No Such Place will be available on PC, and its next playtest will launch on Steam on December 16, 2025.

Investigate anomalous disappearances as a veteran agent from the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.). Scout and loot several hazardous areas across parallel timelines, from ancient, uninhabitable forests to abandoned military outposts and futuristic laboratories.
